title: Want to Subscribe by Email?
content: If you're a regular visitor to this blog — orwantto keep up with it — let me recommend a convenient way to receive updates.It's a free app calledfollow.it. Once you sign up, you can enter the web address (URL) of whatever blogs you like. You can filter your subscription by keyword or frequency. Then you can specify how you would like to receive updates, such as by email or on a single news page.
